$comment: GENERATED by `mineworld reference` from mineworld 0.1.0. Do not edit.

Compatibility.description: A semver range with Cargo's meaning, such as "^0.1" (0.1.x and nothing else). Quote it in YAML.

ConfigurationKey.description: An enabled System Pack's id (such as calendar), or classes (the world's entity classes) or packages (its licence policy). Each names configure/<key>.yaml and is listed once.

EntityKey.description: An authoring key: the name of a file in people/, places/, items/ or organizations/ without .yaml. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

License.description: An SPDX licence expression, such as MIT or MIT OR Apache-2.0, checked against the SPDX licence list.

SystemId.description: The id of a System Pack, such as presence or calendar. 1 to 64 lowercase letters, digits, - and _, not starting or ending with - or _.

WorldIdentity.description: A world's identity: the name a person reads, and the id everything else uses.

id.description: The World Pack's id, which must be its directory's name.

license.description: The pack's licence, an SPDX expression (`ARC-53`). Optional to the loader, checked when stated; required by `mineworld packs validate`. Never world state.

name.description: What the world is called, for a person. Not world state: no system reads it, and nothing in a simulation may branch on it.

version.description: The pack's release version, semver (`DECISIONS.md` `ARC-53`). Optional to the loader, checked when stated; required by `mineworld packs validate`. Never world state.

description: `world.yaml`: what this world is, what it is composed of, and who is in it.

configure.description: The files in `configure/` this world has, in seeding order: each key names `configure/<key>.yaml` — an enabled System Pack's id, or `classes` or `packages`.

items.description: The item kinds this world has. Each key names a file in `items/`: a kind of thing, not one object.

mineworld.description: The framework versions this world is authored for, such as "^0.1"; when stated, a framework outside it is refused by name.

organizations.description: The organizations this world has. Each key names a file in `organizations/`.

places.description: The places this world has. Each key names a file in `places/`.

population.description: The people this world has. Each key names a file in `people/`.

requires.description: Every pack this world uses that is not bundled, with the versions it accepts, such as `modern-goods: "^0.1"`; each is found in a directory given with --packs or MINEWORLD_PACKS.

seats.description: The seats a client may occupy, each the key of a person in `population`.

systems.description: The System Packs this world enables, in installation order.

world.description: The world's own identity: its id and its name.

title: WorldManifest
